en.headline: Ethnic cultural exhibition continues at Hong Kong Cultural Centre until Sunday
en.dek: The free display of handicrafts from Belt and Road countries and regions runs in the foyer through 29 November after last weekend’s carnival.
body: An ethnic cultural exhibition titled Convergence of Cross-Cultural Gifting continues in the foyer of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui until 29 November.

Presented under the Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances+ programme, the free exhibition brings together woven textiles, handicrafts, photographs, oil paintings and porcelain from around 30 Belt and Road countries and regions, including Bangladesh, Cambodia, Egypt, Korea and others.
The accompanying outdoor carnival took place on 22 November. The exhibition is open from 9am to 11pm on weekdays through Saturday, and until 5pm on Sunday the 29th.
The Leisure and Cultural Services Department organised the programme with support from various consulates-general and cultural organisations.

zh.headline: 民族文化展覽於香港文化中心繼續舉行至周日
zh.dek: 免費展出「一帶一路」國家及地區手工藝品，嘉年華過後於大堂展出至11月29日。
body: 以「盛禮薈萃」為主題的民族文化展覽，現正於尖沙咀香港文化中心大堂繼續舉行，展期至11月29日。
展覽屬「亞裔藝采+」節目一部分，免費開放，匯聚約30個「一帶一路」國家及地區的編織品、手工藝品、照片、油畫及瓷器，包括孟加拉、柬埔寨、埃及、韓國等。
相關戶外嘉年華已於11月22日舉行。展覽平日至周六上午9時至晚上11時開放，周日（29日）則至下午5時。
節目由康樂及文化事務署策劃，獲多個總領事館及文化機構支持。
